policy: A trustworthy official link may be used without local capture, retrieval automation, conversion, or hashing. This register accepts only the listed pages within their displayed identity, date, language, and scope. Link acceptance does not accept stored copies, establish topic coverage, or complete the country review.

publisher_basis.publisher: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár (NJT), operated by MKIFK Magyar Közlönykiadó és Igazságügyi Fordítóközpont Zrt.
publisher_basis.evidence: The NJT user manual, updated 2026-06-10, identifies MKIFK as operator and says the public, registration-free service publishes the queried day’s effective law in consolidated form.

hu-act-2007-1.identity: 2007. évi I. törvény — Act on the entry and residence of persons with the right of free movement and residence
hu-act-2007-1.scope: Primary Hungarian free-movement and residence law for EEA citizens and their accompanying or joining family members.
hu-act-2007-1.limitations: This link is accepted as the official consolidated text for the displayed date. It does not establish full topical coverage or the acceptance of the historical local conversion.

hu-gov-2007-113.identity: 113/2007. (V. 24.) Korm. rendelet — implementing decree for Act I of 2007
hu-gov-2007-113.scope: Implementation of Act I of 2007, including authorities, visa and residence procedures, evidence, and review routes shown in the consolidated decree.
hu-gov-2007-113.limitations: Use within the displayed consolidation date and the provisions consulted. This is not a finding that every operational page or remedy is covered.

hu-act-2010-1.identity: 2010. évi I. törvény — Act on civil-registration procedure
hu-act-2010-1.scope: Hungarian civil-registration procedures relevant to records of family status and civil events.
hu-act-2010-1.limitations: This source does not by itself resolve foreign-document recognition, translation, authentication, or evidentiary sufficiency.

hu-act-2016-150.identity: 2016. évi CL. törvény — Act on general administrative procedure
hu-act-2016-150.scope: General Hungarian administrative procedure, including agency duties and procedure applicable unless displaced by a special rule.
hu-act-2016-150.limitations: Application to a particular immigration decision, deadline, or remedy must be checked against the special law and decision.

hu-act-2017-1.identity: 2017. évi I. törvény — Act on administrative court procedure
hu-act-2017-1.scope: Judicial procedure for administrative disputes, including provisions expressly addressing disputes concerning entry and residence.
hu-act-2017-1.limitations: Acceptance of the statute link is not a case-law search and does not resolve the availability or scope of judicial review in a specific immigration matter.

ajbh-equal-treatment-directorate.identity: Official AJBH PDF on data concerning the procedure for handling official cases; title marker checked in the existing source record.
ajbh-equal-treatment-directorate.scope: Historical AJBH administrative/equal-treatment procedure disclosure as identified by its title.
ajbh-equal-treatment-directorate.limitations: The exact currentness date is not established. Do not use it as proof of current forms, deadlines, or a complete remedies route.

ajbh-equal-treatment-request-procedure-2.identity: AJBH 2024 equal-treatment information booklet; the registered text marker identifies its subject.
ajbh-equal-treatment-request-procedure-2.scope: Information on the AJBH equal-treatment procedure as presented in the 2024 booklet.
ajbh-equal-treatment-request-procedure-2.limitations: A dated information booklet, not a current statutory text or proof that its forms and channels remain current.

ajbh-public-interest-whistleblowing-guid.identity: Tájékoztató közérdekű/visszaélés-bejelentés benyújtásának lehetőségéről és feltételeiről, 2025 edition. Official result identifies reporting through the Ombudsman’s protected electronic system.
ajbh-public-interest-whistleblowing-guid.scope: Public-interest and abuse reporting procedure described in the 2025 AJBH guide.
ajbh-public-interest-whistleblowing-guid.limitations: This is not an individual immigration complaint or appeal route. Current channels and forms remain subject to whole-site human review.

hu-act-2023-25.identity: 2023. évi XXV. törvény on complaints, public-interest reports, and whistleblowing rules.
hu-act-2023-25.scope: Official consolidated statute on public-authority complaints and public-interest/whistleblowing reports, within the text displayed on 29 July 2026.
hu-act-2023-25.limitations: This is not a visa refusal appeal or a substitute for decision-specific administrative/judicial remedies. The displayed version date is the cutoff accepted here; later currentness is not certified.

local_copy_acceptance.note: All previously converted files remain unaccepted review artifacts. The hu-act-2023-25 Markdown conversion had visible NJT page-menu/search/toolbar chrome; on 2026-10-23 that interface noise was removed and its body hash was recomputed against the text after the source-title heading. The body hash now matches the cleaned Markdown. The stored raw-byte hash could not be replayed because no captured source bytes were found in this checkout or the sibling /tmp/public-data checkout, and the configured runtime-storage module is absent from this checkout, so the cleaned file remains unaccepted. The 2010 civil-registration Act and three AJBH PDFs remain link-only; no local copy was accepted.

whole_site_review_offers.reason: The official domain and document identities are clear, but direct page retrieval returned 403 in this review client and the live status of complaint, equal-treatment, and protected-reporting routes is not established.
whole_site_review_offers.review_question: Can a reviewer inspect the whole official AJBH site and identify the current pages, forms, submission channels, scope, and version dates for individual Ombudsman complaints, equal-treatment cases, and public-interest/abuse reports?
whole_site_review_offers.effect: The three official links remain usable within their dated/document scopes. No local copies or remedies topics are accepted. The pending review does not block other Hungary source work.
